title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying the Preface Written by General Secretary Jiang Zemin for "The Legal Library of the People's Republic of China"
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying the Preface Written by General Secretary Jiang Zemin for the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China*

Fa Fa [2002] No. 18

To: All Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China*, the most comprehensive, systematic, and practical large-scale reference book compiling laws, administrative regulations, and judicial interpretations to date, with Chief Justice and President of the Supreme People's Court Xiao Yang as the chief editor-in-chief and reviewed by the Legislative Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, was published and distributed by the People's Court Press in October 2002. General Secretary Jiang Zemin personally wrote the preface for this book. On October 16, major media outlets nationwide broadcast the Xinhua News Agency report on General Secretary Jiang Zemin's preface to the *Compilation of Laws*.

General Secretary Jiang Zemin's *Preface* to the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China*, standing at the height of history and the times, incisively summarizes the historical experience of our Party and state in valuing legal system construction, profoundly discusses the importance and urgency of strengthening legal system construction and forming a complete legal system under the new circumstances, and correctly answers major issues urgently needing resolution in the practice of governing the country according to law and building a socialist rule-of-law state. It is a great achievement combining the basic principles of Marxism with the realities of the contemporary world and China's development and changes, a system of rule-of-law theory that is consistent with Marxism, Mao Zedong Thought, and Deng Xiaoping Theory, and the latest development of our Party's thought on governing the Party and the state. It has significant theoretical guiding significance for further developing socialist democratic politics and building a socialist rule-of-law state in the new century.

Earnestly studying Comrade Jiang Zemin's *Preface* to the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China* is of great significance for deeply understanding the basic strategy of governing the country according to law, adhering to the direction of socialist democratic politics, building a socialist rule-of-law state, advancing and perfecting all work related to the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, and promoting the construction of socialist democratic politics in our country. The study of Comrade Jiang Zemin's *Preface* to the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China* should be closely integrated with the study of *Jiang Zemin on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics (Special Excerpts)*. The theoretical ideas on China's democratic politics and legal system construction in the *Preface* are an important component of Comrade Jiang Zemin's important expositions on building socialism with Chinese characteristics and have become a powerful ideological weapon for China's legislation, law enforcement, judiciary, and legal popularization work, especially for the people's courts in promoting court reform and development, and have important guiding significance for the trial work of people's courts at all levels nationwide. People's courts at all levels nationwide should earnestly carry out activities to study the *Preface* written by General Secretary Jiang Zemin for the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China*, closely combine it with the actual work of the people's courts, deeply understand the rich connotation and spiritual essence of the *Preface*, and, in accordance with Comrade Jiang Zemin's important thought of the "Three Represents" and a series of important expositions on socialist legal system construction, further strengthen trial work, actively and steadily promote court reform, vigorously strengthen the professionalization of the judge contingent, strive to achieve the century's work theme of "justice and efficiency," and continuously open up new prospects for the work of the people's courts.

People's courts at all levels should attach great importance to this study activity, carefully organize it, and earnestly deploy it to ensure that the study activity is implemented and achieves practical results. When organizing the study, they should proactively invite leading comrades from the local Party committee and People's Congress to participate to strengthen leadership of the study activity. At the same time, they should do a good job in publicizing and distributing the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China* to local Party and government organs, especially judicial organs, administrative law enforcement organs, judicial administrative departments, and enterprises and institutions, to expand its social impact.

This notice shall be complied with immediately.

October 17, 2002

Preface to the *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China*

Since the founding of the People's Republic of China, our country's legal system construction has continuously developed in practice, accumulating important experience and achieving significant results. We have deeply realized that governing the country according to law and building a socialist rule-of-law state are important guarantees for the success of the great cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics and for achieving national prosperity, strength, and long-term stability. In September 1997, the Fifteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China clearly put forward the basic strategy of governing the country according to law and the important task of building a socialist rule-of-law state. On March 15, 1999, the Second Session of the Ninth National People's Congress incorporated governing the country according to law and building a socialist rule-of-law state into the *Amendment to the Constitution of the People's Republic of China*. This marked a new period of development for China's legal system construction.

Law is both a product of social development and has an effect on social development. The more developed the economy and the more progressive society becomes, the more necessary it is to guide and regulate economic and social life through the rule of law. Governing the country according to law is an effective way for us to manage state affairs, economic and cultural undertakings, and social affairs. Only by strictly regulating the operation of state power in accordance with the Constitution and laws can we ensure that the people exercise state power and enjoy extensive civil rights according to law. Only with complete laws and systems as guarantees can we ensure the orderly development of the socialist market economy. Only by correctly using legal means to effectively adjust and resolve various social conflicts can we ensure the long-term stability of the country and society and the peaceful livelihood of the people. When laws and decrees are enforced, the country is well-governed; when laws and decrees are relaxed, the country falls into chaos. This is a principle of governance proven by history both in China and abroad.

Forming a complete legal system is the foundation of governing the country according to law. We have already made clear that a socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics should be formed by 2010. This is the primary task in advancing the process of governing the country according to law. To build a socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, we must adhere to the guidance of Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and Deng Xiaoping Theory, implement the requirements of the "Three Represents," and uphold the socialist nature and direction of our legal system. We must, based on national conditions, formulate and implement laws that reflect the will and interests of the people and conform to the laws of social development. On the basis of our Constitution, we must form a socialist legal system that is unified in structure, logically rigorous in organization, complete in legal departments, and scientifically arranged in form, so that all state work and all aspects of social life have laws to follow.

Achieving the goal of governing the country according to law and building a socialist rule-of-law state requires long-term efforts. At present, we have initially established a socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics and have also made significant progress in advancing the legalization of state and social management. However, the tasks of legislation and law amendment we face are still heavy, and there is still much work to be done in implementing the basic strategy of governing the country according to law. After China's accession to the World Trade Organization, exercising rights and fulfilling obligations under the WTO legal framework also requires further improvement of our legal system. We must, based on the requirements of economic and social development, strive to reflect the will of the people, vigorously strengthen legislative work, vigorously promote judicial reform, vigorously promote law-based administration, vigorously strengthen legal education and research, vigorously popularize legal knowledge throughout society, and, in particular, vigorously enhance the legal awareness and ability to act according to law of cadres at all levels. In short, realizing the legalization of national economic, political, and cultural life is an inevitable requirement of China's socialist modernization, and we must make unremitting efforts to achieve this goal.

The *Compilation of Laws of the People's Republic of China* is a comprehensive legal book reflecting the achievements of our country's legal system construction. Editing and publishing this large-scale legal book is a very meaningful foundational work. I believe that the publication of this book will help promote the construction of our country's socialist democratic politics, help perfect the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, and, in particular, help advance the process of governing the country according to law and building a socialist rule-of-law state.

Jiang Zemin

July 12, 2002
